current_sources: Reference plate identifier from the merged filenames, such as plate2. Leave blank to use the first plate by name. The selected plate must be present in this run. Default blank.
The selected reference plate is used; leave it blank to use the first plate by name.

Calibrate intensities across imaging sessions before measuring: each plate is one session, the beads or reference wells imaged on every plate are measured, and every plate's intensity channels are scaled so its reference wells match the selected reference plate's; a blank reference plate setting uses the first plate by name. This corrects exposure, lamp and detector drift between days at the image level, unlike batch correction of tables. The gains are recorded in measurements.db:intensity_rescale. Default False.
